title: Sigandur Chowdeshwari Mahime
desc: Goddess Sigandooru Chowdeshwari rescues her sincere devotees who are stuck in dire circumstances and sincerely seek her divine protection.

title: Janumada Jodi
desc: A lovelorn village boy, Krishna, and a girl, Kanaka, cross all barriers of caste and tradition to unite in a meaningful manner.

title: Ee Bandhana
desc: An old couple sacrifices everything, so their children live a happy life. However, they are forced to separate and subjected to ill-treatment and disrespect in their children's homes.

title: Bharjari
desc: Surya, an orphan raised by the best friend of his deceased mother, wants to become a soldier. He falls in love with a woman but soon gets an offer to join the army.

title: Hanuman
desc: A mischievous Hanuman grows up to become a heroic being who fights all evil creatures and helps Lord Rama in rescuing Sita from Lanka.
